subject: PO billing cadence & discount eligibility for annual commitment
messages:
From: Adam Levin <adam.levin@spectrahealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@spectrahealth.com, s.cho@spectrahealth.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: PO: Redwood Inference - Annual Commitment (draft PO)

Hi Laura,

We're preparing a PO for an annual Redwood commitment and wanted to run billing/discount logistics by you before we route internally. Procurement prefers a PO on file that references an SOW, and they want to split the invoices into quarterly billings (4 x invoices) rather than a single annual invoice. Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt.

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood accept a PO that covers an annual commitment but invoices quarterly?
- Will Redwood honor the discount discussed in the commercial conversation (Adam had mentions of up to 20%) and what are the criteria (prepay vs. commit vs. ARR threshold)?
- Any preferred PO fields or wording procurement needs so AP can match quickly?

I've attached a draft PO (SpectraHealth_PO_Draft.pdf) and procurement contact is Sarah Cho (cc'd). If we can get a short confirmation on cadence and discount rules, I'll move it through procurement.

Thanks,
Adam Levin
Director, Strategic Procurement
Spectra Health

Subject: Re: PO: Redwood Inference - Annual Commitment (draft PO)

Adam —

Thanks for the PO and the clear asks. Short answers up front:
- We can accept a PO that covers an annual commitment and invoice on a quarterly cadence (4 invoices).
- Net 30 is our standard for enterprise customers; we can accept that pending AP checks.
- Discount: our standard commercial discounting runs on tiers. For a 12-month commitment at ~ $350k ARR we typically authorize up to 15%. 20% is reserved for either (a) prepayment/annual upfront payment or (b) larger commitments (>$500k ARR) and requires VP approval.

Action items from our side:
- Please include PO referencing the Redwood SOW number and line: "Redwood SOW TBD - attach SOW before first invoice." That helps our billing match.
- Please share the exact billing contact and remit-to details procurement will use.
- We'll provide a short billing instruction PDF and our SOW template.

I'm cc'ing Ben Carter from Sales Ops to help surface any finance constraints. I will follow up after internal sign-off.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Ben/Rishi —
Forwarding Spectra's PO ask. Key points: quarterly invoicing on a single PO, net30, discount ask 'up to 20%'. The commercial team has them at ~ $350k committed ARR for 12 months. Question: can Sales Ops/Finance approve 15% concession for this ARR level and allow the quarterly split? Or do we require prepayment to get to 20%?

>
> Thanks for the PO and the clear asks. Short answers up front:
> - We can accept a PO that covers an annual commitment and invoice on a quarterly cadence (4 invoices).

> - Discount: our standard commercial discounting runs on tiers. For a 12-month commitment at ~ $350k ARR we typically authorize up to 15%. 20% is reserved for either (a) prepayment/annual upfront payment or (b) larger commitments (>$500k ARR) and requires VP approval.

Ben (Sales Ops): thoughts on SOW attachment requirement and whether finance needs additional PO language to ensure match?

—Laura

Subject: Re: PO: Redwood Inference - Annual Commitment (confirmation & next steps)

Adam —

Thanks for the draft PO and for walking procurement through this. Confirming Redwood's position so procurement has one place to reference:

1) Invoice cadence: We will accept a single PO that covers an annual commitment and invoice on a quarterly cadence (4 invoices). Invoices will be issued on the schedule you propose and each will be Net 30.

2) Discount eligibility: For a 12-month commitment at ~$350k ARR we can approve a 15% contract-level discount. The 20% rate is only available if Spectra elects one of the following: (a) full-year prepayment (single invoice upfront), or (b) a minimum $500k ARR commitment. 20% also requires VP commercial sign-off.

3) Required artifacts for AP: Please attach the signed Redwood SOW (use the RDW_SOW_template_v2.docx attached), include remit-to and ACH details on the PO, and reference the SOW number on each invoice line to avoid matching delays. Our AP team will validate against the PO + SOW before payment.

4) Next steps:
- Please return the PO with the remit-to fields completed and attach the signed SOW.
- If Spectra wants to request 20% we can discuss prepayment options and escalate for approval.

I've attached the SOW template and an example of our billing instructions. Once we receive the completed PO + signed SOW, we'll countersign and confirm the invoice schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

—Laura Bennett
